title: REPRESENTATION OF PROFESSIONS IN ENTERTAINMENT MEDIA: INSIGHTS INTO FREQUENCY AND SENTIMENT TRENDS THROUGH COMPUTATIONAL TEXT ANALYSIS
benchmark_measurement: The frequency of mentions and the sentiment expressed (positive, negative, neutral) towards religious professions in movie and television subtitles from 1950-2017.
models_tested: EWISER (Enhanced WSD Integrating Synset Embeddings and Relations)
findings: The study found that mentions of religious professions like bishops, reverends, and priests have decreased over time, while mentions of pastors, deacons, imams, lamas, and rabbis have increased. Regarding sentiment, religious workers such as monks and nuns are portrayed more negatively than positively. The proportion of negative sentiment towards priests increases specifically in crime genre media.
